AGRICULTURE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #3
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: AGRICULTURE
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Petrol fires have no fuel
   B. Water removes heat too quickly
   C. Water always increases oxygen
   D. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely

2. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. A mixture of two liquids
   B. Any substance that conducts electricity
   C. Any white crystal used in cooking
   D. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means

3. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. watt (W)
   B. joule (J)
   C. newton (N)
   D. pascal (Pa)

4. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   B. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   C. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   D. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya

5. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   B. Movement of water only across a membrane
   C. A chemical reaction forming ash
   D. Heating until a solid melts

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Properties of soil? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Properties of soil.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Properties of soil.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Properties of soil.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Properties of soil.

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Land Preparation? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Land Preparation.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Land Preparation.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Land Preparation.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Land Preparation.

8. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 100 °C
   B. 37 °C
   C. 0 °C
   D. 50 °C

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Safe Handling of Animals? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Safe Handling of Animals.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Safe Handling of Animals.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Safe Handling of Animals.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Safe Handling of Animals.

10. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Producers
   B. Tertiary consumers
   C. Primary consumers only
   D. Decomposers only

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Agricultural Land? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Agricultural Land.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Agricultural Land.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Agricultural Land.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Agricultural Land.

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying General Crop Harvesting 2.0 Animal Production 2.1 Breeds of Livestock 2.2 Safe H? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for General Crop Harvesting 2.0 Animal Production 2.1 Breeds of Livestock 2.2 Safe H.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about General Crop Harvesting 2.0 Animal Production 2.1 Breeds of Livestock 2.2 Safe H.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to General Crop Harvesting 2.0 Animal Production 2.1 Breeds of Livestock 2.2 Safe H.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on General Crop Harvesting 2.0 Animal Production 2.1 Breeds of Livestock 2.2 Safe H.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Agricultural Land and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Properties of soil and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Land Preparation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Field Management Practices and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. D — Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely

2. D — A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means

3. C — newton (N)

4. B — Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio

5. A — Net movement of particles from high to low concentration

6. D — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Properties of soil.

7. A — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Land Preparation.

8. A — 100 °C

9. D — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Safe Handling of Animals.

10. A — Producers

11. A — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Agricultural Land.

12. A — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for General Crop Harvesting 2.0 Animal Production 2.1 Breeds of Livestock 2.2 Safe H.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Land Preparation; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
